Context & provenance

About this edition.

The surviving excerpt of the Muwatta' of 'Abd Allah b. Wahb (d. 197 AH), presented in its printed page and report order. This is not the complete original work.

The edition

  • TextMuwaṭṭaʾ ʿAbd Allāh ibn Wahb (surviving excerpt)
  • CompilerʿAbd Allāh ibn Wahb (d. 197 AH)
  • Extent520 narrations

How the text is presented

Structure

The supplied excerpt has no separate chapter-heading records. Reports are shown in their original page-record and printed-number order, with printed page references. The reader provides search by report number and text; no chapter divisions have been added.

Completeness

Surviving excerpt, printed pages 27–152 of the 152-page edition; not the complete original Muwatta' Printed report number 456 is absent from the supplied source; all other numbered reports from 1 through 521 are present.

Translation

The English text is reproduced as supplied in the organized translation. Arabic wording and the report numbering are preserved.

The opening and closing material

Title pages, the chain through which the copy was transmitted, and notes that frame the text are kept here. They are not counted among the narrations.

Section: Books of the Sunna. Book: Muwatta' 'Abd Allah b. Wahb (surviving excerpt). Author: Abu Muhammad 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Misri al-Qurashi (d. 197 AH). Editor: Hisham Isma'il al-Sini. Publisher: Dar Ibn al-Jawzi (Dammam). Second edition, Jumada al-Akhira 1420 AH / 1999 CE. 152 printed pages. Released on al-Shamila on 8 Dhu al-Hijja 1431 AH.
